scripts.dev: npm run codegen && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next dev site
scripts.build: npm run codegen && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build site
scripts.lint: eslint site scripts tests eslint.config.mjs panda.config.ts panda --max-warnings=0
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck: npm run codegen && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next typegen site && tsc --project site/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.panda.json --noEmit
